selector.rationale: Vaginal biopsy showed grade 3 endometrioid adenocarcinoma, and PET-CT showed multiple hypermetabolic masses in the pelvis, abdomen, and chest, which supports the diagnosis of Endometrioid adenocarcinoma. Iatrogenic tumor dissemination is considered as a runner-up due to the history of supracervical laparoscopic hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy with prolonged mechanical morcellation without a containment bag.

rejected.label: Disseminated peritoneal leiomyomatosis
rejected.why: No evidence of leiomyomatosis in the pathology re-review of the hysterectomy and oophorectomy specimens

rejected.label: Endometriosis
rejected.why: Superficial pelvic endometriosis was noted and cauterized during surgery, but it does not explain the multiple hypermetabolic masses in the pelvis, abdomen, and chest

rejected.label: Leiomyomatosis peritonealis disseminata
rejected.why: No evidence of leiomyomatosis in the pathology re-review of the hysterectomy and oophorectomy specimens, and the clinical presentation is more consistent with Endometrioid adenocarcinoma
